target_questions.question: Can an open URANS-WENO workflow reproduce the underexpanded-jet quantities needed for engine engineering studies?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 A028 already frames fidelity-cost tradeoffs; this paper is checked for a distinct Tier 3 method contribution.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: The open URANS-WENO implementation reproduces barrel-shock, cone-angle, and hydrogen-air mixing trends for NPR 8.5-30 while targeting lower-cost engine-cycle analysis.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: Pressure-based compressible URANS results are compared with experimental and LES data to define method capability and limits.

limitations: Primarily methodological and substantially overlaps the established fidelity-cost framework; no new physical mechanism is isolated.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
